# authwise_guard_tenants (Data Source)

A Guard tenant, under a parent Authwise tenant. Nothing else in Guard exists until this does. awtenant creates it; the provider only reads it. `users` is where the tenant's people sign in and are decided. This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `guard_tenants` (Attributes List) Every tenant under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--guard_tenants))

<a id="nestedatt--guard_tenants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `guard_tenants`

Read-Only:

- `config` (String)
- `created_by` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `guard_tenant_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `name` (String) Full resource name.
- `parent_tenant_id` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `users` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--guard_tenants--users))

<a id="nestedatt--guard_tenants--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `guard_tenants.users`

Read-Only:

- `audience` (String)

- `tenant_id` (String)
